patterns_discovered.description: All UI components accept ThemeColors and use useMemo to memoize dynamic styles based on theme colors
patterns_discovered.benefit: Ensures consistent theme application and performance optimization through memoization

patterns_discovered.description: Simple atomic components (StatRow, Toggle) composed into complex containers (StatsDisplay, SettingsModal)
patterns_discovered.benefit: Promotes reusability and maintains single responsibility principle

patterns_discovered.description: All components receive configuration through props rather than relying on context or global state
patterns_discovered.benefit: Maximum flexibility and testability, explicit data flow

patterns_discovered.description: Each component exports explicit interface definitions for props and complex data structures
patterns_discovered.benefit: Type safety and better IDE support

patterns_discovered.description: Functional components using React.FC type annotation with full TypeScript support

gotchas_discovered.gotcha: Color prop passing through component chains
gotchas_discovered.context: Colors prop must be passed through multiple component levels (e.g., StatsDisplay -> StatRow)
gotchas_discovered.resolution: Could benefit from Context API to reduce prop drilling in future iterations

gotchas_discovered.context: Components create StyleSheet.create() at module level but dynamicStyles within useMemo
gotchas_discovered.resolution: Current approach is correct; mixing static and dynamic styles appropriately
